title: Treatment Readiness Enterprise Experience
acceptance_criteria: Visitors can navigate the public landing, sign-in, and trust surfaces, understand OncoReady's enterprise value, and encounter no unsupported deployment, customer, outcome, certification, compliance, or live-integration claims.
Clickable sandbox entry reaches staff, patient, and caregiver perspectives without accepting or implying verification of real credentials.
A persistent staff shell reaches Command Center, Exceptions, Patients, Resources, Insights, Integrations, and Admin with clear current-location and return behavior.
Every staff module contains complete, coherent synthetic enterprise content; secondary modules may be static/read-only but may not present dead consequential controls or misleading live state.
Staff search and exception/patient filters work against fixtures, combine predictably, provide useful no-result states, and can be cleared without resetting the workflow.
Maria's readiness submission with an unconfirmed ride and clinical concern creates exactly one navigation task and one human clinical-review task from deterministic local state.
Maria's clinical concern remains verbatim inert text and is never represented as automated triage, diagnosis, treatment advice, or medical clearance.
Command Center, Exceptions, Patients/Maria case, the Treatment Readiness Graph, patient status, and timeline derive Maria's risk, ownership, next action, and state from one source of truth.
Staff can acknowledge clinical review and confirm simulated transportation while guarded transitions prevent invalid, duplicate, or out-of-order advancement.
Resources supports Maria's simulated transport action while broader availability remains clearly synthetic rather than a live booking network.
Ana's caregiver portal exposes only Maria-authorized transportation information and excludes clinical content from visible and accessibility-specific output.
Maria's final acknowledgment is gated on required staff actions, supplies closure evidence exactly once, and moves the shared plan to confirmed.
Synthetic Insights, sandbox/proposed Integrations, and local/read-only Admin remain coherent with Maria's current workflow and make no server-enforcement or production-connectivity claims.
Refresh safely restores compatible progress or reinitializes, and reset restores workflow, permissions, search/filters, and sandbox perspective to one known opening state.

Applicable public, staff, patient, and caregiver surfaces are complete at mobile and presentation-laptop sizes, keyboard operable, visibly focused, semantic, non-color-dependent, and equivalent under reduced motion.

No primary navigation is dead and no surface contains starter content, real PHI, exposed secrets, real credential collection, or unsupported compliance, certification, production-scale, clinical-validation, measured-outcome, or live-vendor claims. Normal product surfaces do not describe OncoReady as a prototype, demo, dummy, mock, or toy; non-production context is disclosed discreetly with professional environment language such as Training environment or Illustrative records only where materially necessary.

The frontend runs without live network services after installation; build and smoke checks cover entry, primary route reachability, search/filter recovery, reset-to-confirmed Maria completion, and caregiver clinical-data exclusion.
